definitions.short: something stamped to pieces , i.e. a bit
definitions.full: H1917. haddam [ הַדָּם ] noun [masculine] member, limb (loan-word from Persian , id. Lag Ges. Abh. 28 Fl Levy ChWB i. 423 b ); plural absolute תִּתְעַבְדוּן הַדָּמִין Dan 2:5 ye shall be made members , i.e. dismembered , so 3:29 .
